DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 広報の朗読のお手伝いについてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about helping with readings of the public information bulletin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。試しに一段落録りました。途中で家族が話しかけた声も入ったので、このまま送るか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朗読試録へ家族声が混ざり送付可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I recorded one paragraph as a trial. A family member spoke to me partway through and their voice was recorded too, so I am unsure whether to send it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a family member's voice got into your trial reading and ask whether you can send it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、ご自身で最後まで聞いてみてください。録り直したい段落はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please listen to it yourself all the way through. Have you decided which paragraph you want to record again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 催しの紹介の段落です。家族の声は本文ではないので、静かな時に同じ段落を最初から録り直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 催し紹介段落を静かな時に最初から録り直すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The paragraph introducing the event. My family's voice is not part of the text, so I will record the same paragraph again from the beginning when it is quiet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record the event introduction paragraph again from the beginning when it is quiet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ渡す時は、読んだ見出しも知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: When you give it to the person in charge, please also tell them the heading you read.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「春の音楽会」です。その見出しから読み始めます。難しい地名が一つあるので、読み方を先に聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見出し春の音楽会を示し架空地名読みに事前質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is ‘Spring Concert.’ I will start reading from that heading. There is one place name that is difficult, so could I ask how to pronounce it beforehand?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the heading ‘Spring Concert’ and ask beforehand how to pronounce the fictional place name. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この案内では「青野町」で、「あおのちょう」と読みます。手元の原稿にも仮名を添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this notice, it is Aonocho, pronounced ‘a-o-no-cho.’ Please add the pronunciation to your copy of the script as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あおのちょうですね。原稿へ書きました。録り直したら、見出しと最後の文まで入ったか聞き返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青野町読みを原稿へ記し見出し末文まで録音確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Aonocho, right. I have written it on the script. After recording again, I will listen back to check that it includes the heading through the final sentence.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you wrote the pronunciation of Aonocho on the script and will check the recording includes everything from the heading to the final sentence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送る方法は、担当からこちらの連絡先でご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain how to send it through this contact information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その案内をいただきます。今日はまだ送らず、家で一段落を録り直して確認します。元の混ざった方とは分けて保存します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送付方法案内を受取り録直し確認後元録音と別保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for those instructions. I will not send it today; I will record the paragraph again at home and check it. I will save it separately from the original with the other voice in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will receive the sending instructions, record again and check it, and keep it separately from the original recording.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へご希望をお伝えします。ご協力ありがとうございます。録音のご準備をよろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will let the person in charge know your wishes. Thank you for your cooperation. Please prepare the recording.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お仕事の様子を、診察で伝える準備をされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you preparing to explain what your work is like at your medical appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「立つ仕事」とだけ書きましたが、一日ずっと同じ所にいると思われるかもしれません。時間も説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 立つ仕事一語では一日連続に誤解されそうで時間説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I only wrote ‘standing work,’ but they may think I stay in the same place all day. I would like to explain the times as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that ‘standing work’ alone may suggest standing continuously all day, and that you want to explain the times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 立っている時間と、休む時間について、分かる範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me, as far as you know, how long you stand and when you rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 品物を並べる時は、三十分ほど立ちます。そのあと座って数を記録するので、毎回は連続していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一回三十分の品出し後座る記録があると具体化する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: When arranging products, I stand for about thirty minutes. After that I sit down to record the quantities, so it is not continuous each time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese that each thirty-minute period of stocking is followed by recording while seated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一回に立つ長さとして、三十分と添えられます。座る作業も、同じ日の中にあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can add thirty minutes as the length of each period of standing. You also do seated work during the same day, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。座って記録する時間は十分くらいです。午後は並べる回数が違うので、毎日同じ合計にはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 座る十分と午後回数変動で固定合計不可と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I spend about ten minutes recording while seated. The number of times I arrange products in the afternoon varies, so the total is not the same every day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you sit for ten minutes and the number of afternoon sessions varies, so there is no fixed total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その違いも、担当へお話しください。気になっている時は、どの作業中でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the person in charge about that variation too. During which task do you notice the discomfort?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 立って並べている後半に、足が重く感じます。座る記録の時には、同じ感じではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 立作業後半の足の重さと座る時の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My legs feel heavy in the latter part of standing and arranging products. They do not feel the same when I sit to record the quantities.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the heaviness in your legs toward the end of standing work and how it differs when sitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お仕事の説明と、その時の感じ方を合わせて担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on both your work description and how you feel at that time to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。一回三十分、そのあと座る記録十分、午後の回数は日によると書き足します。続けてよいかは、診察で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 作業と時間を追記し継続可否は診察で相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will add that each period is thirty minutes, followed by ten minutes recording while seated, and the number of afternoon sessions depends on the day. I will ask at the appointment whether I can continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will add the tasks and times and ask at your appointment whether you can continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、そのメモをお持ちになってお待ちください。担当にご説明いただけます。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait with that note. You can explain it to the person in charge. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談先の地図について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the map of places to seek advice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 赤と青の印が似て見えます。防犯の相談をしたい場所を探していますが、色だけでは分けにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 赤青が似て見え防犯相談場所を色だけで判別困難と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The red and blue marks look similar to me. I am looking for somewhere to consult about crime prevention, but I find it hard to distinguish them by color alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that red and blue look similar and it is difficult to identify the crime-prevention consultation location by color alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図では、丸の印が警察の相談先、四角の印が市の窓口です。下にも文字で説明があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this map, circles indicate police consultation locations, and squares indicate city service counters. There is a written explanation below as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 形なら分かります。私の家の近くには、丸と四角が一つずつあるので、丸の方を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 丸警察四角市を理解し家近くの丸を選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can tell them apart by shape. There is one circle and one square near my house, so I will look at the circle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand circles mean police and squares mean city offices, and will choose the circle near your home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どちらの丸をご覧でしょうか。指していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which circle are you looking at? Could you point to it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 学校の横にある、この丸です。赤い方と言う代わりに、学校の横の丸と伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 学校横の丸を指し色でなく位置形で説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This circle next to the school. Instead of saying the red one, I would like to describe it as the circle next to the school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point to the circle beside the school and describe it by position and shape instead of color. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その丸の名前は「北通り相談所」です。受付の案内は、こちらの別の紙にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That circle is called Kitadori Consultation Office. Reception information is on this separate sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 北通り相談所ですね。丸の横へ名前を自分で書き足してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 架空北通り相談所名を確認し自己地図へ文字追記を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kitadori Consultation Office, right. May I write the name beside the circle myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the fictional name Kitadori Consultation Office and ask to add its name to your own map. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の地図へどうぞ。受付の日時も、別の案内でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do on your own map. Also check the reception days and hours in the separate notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前を書けました。地図で場所を見て、案内の連絡先へ受付を聞きます。家族へは色だけでなく、丸と名前で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前追記後別紙連絡先で受付を聞き家族へ形名で説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written the name. I will find the location on the map and ask about reception using the contact details in the notice. I will explain it to my family using the circle and the name, as well as the color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that after adding the name, you will ask about reception using the separate contact sheet and explain it to your family by shape and name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、二枚の案内をお持ちください。ご相談の準備にお役立てください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take both information sheets. I hope they help you prepare for your consultation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 印紙をお買い求めでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to buy revenue stamps?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族から「二百円の印紙を二枚」と頼まれました。手紙に貼る切手ではなく、収入印紙で合っているか、このメモを見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族依頼二百円印紙二枚のメモで収入印紙か商品名確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My family asked me for two 200-yen stamps. Please look at this note and check that they mean revenue stamps, rather than postage stamps for letters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Use the note requesting two 200-yen stamps to ask whether the product is revenue stamps. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモには「収入印紙」とあります。二百円の収入印紙を二枚ご用意するご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The note says revenue stamps. You would like two 200-yen revenue stamps, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その二枚です。書類へ貼るのは家族なので、私はここで貼らず、買って渡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族が貼付するため未貼付で購入して渡したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Those two, please. My family will put them on the documents, so I would like to buy them and hand them over without sticking them on here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your family will attach them, so you want to buy them unattached and hand them over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらに二百円の物を二枚ご用意できます。合計四百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can provide two 200-yen stamps here. The total is 400 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二百円が二枚で四百円ですね。合計の四百円と、印紙一枚の二百円をメモに分けて書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二百円二枚合計四百円を確認し一枚額面二百円と総額四百円を別に記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two at 200 yen makes 400 yen, right. I will write the total of 400 yen and the 200-yen value of one stamp separately on the note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm two 200-yen stamps total 400 yen and write the individual face value and total separately. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、二枚です。お受け取りになる時に、額面と枚数をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, two stamps. Please check the face value and quantity when you receive them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どちらにも二百円とあります。二枚そろっています。このまま家族のメモと一緒に持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二枚の額面と枚数を見て依頼メモとともに持ち帰りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both say 200 yen. There are two of them. I would like to take them home as they are, together with my family’s note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the face value and number of the two stamps and say you want to take them home with the request note. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの包みをお使いください。お支払いは四百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use this wrapper. The payment is 400 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四百円を払います。二枚を包みに入れました。家族には、収入印紙二百円を二枚買ったと伝えて、貼っていないまま渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四百円支払と二枚収納を示し家族へ未貼付で渡すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pay 400 yen. I have put both in the wrapper. I will tell my family I bought two 200-yen revenue stamps and hand them over without attaching them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are paying 400 yen and have packed both stamps, and will hand them to your family unattached.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらをお持ちください。お買い求めいただきありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here you are, then. Thank you for your purchase. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のコードを、こちらへお見せいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you show me your reservation code here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯で開きましたが、文字を大きくしたままなので、コードの右側が画面の外です。このままで読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拡大画面で予約コード右端が欠け読取可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I opened it on my phone, but I left the text enlarged, so the right side of the code is off the screen. Can you read it like this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the reservation code can be scanned when its right edge is cut off on the enlarged screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 四角いコード全体が見えるように戻してみてください。画面の文字は、後で一緒に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please try returning it to a size where the entire square code is visible. We can check the text on the screen together afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 指で小さく戻しました。上と下は入っていますが、まだ右の端が隠れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 縮小後上下は見え右端未表示と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I pinched it smaller. The top and bottom fit, but the right edge is still hidden.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that after zooming out, the top and bottom are visible but the right edge is still missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: もう少し全体が入る大きさにしてください。四つの端を見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please make it a little smaller so the whole thing fits. Let us check all four edges.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 全部入りました。今は文字を読むより、コードをこちらへ見せるための大きさにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四端全体表示を確認しコード提示用大きさにしたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It all fits now. I have set the size to show you the code, rather than to read the text right now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that all four edges are visible and you have sized it for showing the code.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 読み取れました。こちらの予約は、本日の午後三時、グエン様でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: It scanned successfully. Is this reservation for Nguyen at three this afternoon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三時のグエンで合っています。家族の予約も携帯にありますが、今日は自分の方を開きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人十五時予約を確認し家族別予約ではないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, Nguyen at three is correct. My family’s reservation is on my phone too, but today I opened my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your own 3 p.m. reservation and explain it is not your family’s separate reservation. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご予約の受付を確認できました。携帯はお手元へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your reservation check-in is confirmed. Please take your phone back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 戻しました。相談の資料を鞄から出して待ちます。帰宅したら、読む時の文字の大きさへ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯を戻し資料準備待機後帰宅で文字表示調整すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have put it away. I will take the consultation documents out of my bag and wait. When I get home, I will restore the text size I use for reading.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have put your phone away, will prepare your documents and wait, and adjust the text display when you get home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご案内までこちらでお待ちください。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here until we show you through. Thank you for coming today. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 三個のお買い上げをお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you thinking of buying three?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「よりどり三個」とあります。同じ味を三個取るのでしょうか。それとも、違う物を混ぜられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: よりどり三個で同味必須か別味混合可か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says “choose any three.” Do I have to take three of the same flavor, or can I mix different ones?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether “choose any three” requires the same flavor or allows mixing flavors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この印のあるお菓子から、三個を選べます。同じ味でも、違う味でも結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can choose three sweets bearing this mark. They may be the same flavor or different flavors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、この青い袋と黄色い袋を一つずつにします。隣の大きい袋も、三つ目にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青黄各一個を選び大袋も対象か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will take one each of this blue bag and the yellow bag. Can the large bag beside them be my third?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose one blue and one yellow bag and check whether the large bag is included. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きい袋には印がないので、この組み合わせの対象ではありません。小さいこちらには同じ印があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The large bag has no mark, so it is not eligible for this combination. This small one has the same mark.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい赤い袋を選びます。青、黄、赤で三個そろいました。別の大きい方は買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 印のある小赤袋へ替え三種類三個をそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will choose the small red bag. That makes three: blue, yellow, and red. I will not buy the other, larger one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Switch to the marked small red bag and complete the three-item selection with three varieties. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この三個は、合わせて五百四十円です。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一個ずつの値札では二百円ですが、この印の三個なら五百四十円ですね。その組み合わせでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単価二百円と架空三個五百四十円を区別して組合会計を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The individual price tags say 200 yen, but three with this mark are 540 yen, right? I would like that combination, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the individual 200-yen price from the fictional three-for-540-yen offer and ask to pay for the combination. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。この三個をお会計します。ほかの商品はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I will ring up these three. Do you have any other items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は三個だけです。レシートでも三個の組み合わせを見て、家族と一つずつ分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他品なしでレシート組合確認後家族と分けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Just these three today. I will check the three-item combination on the receipt too, then share them with my family, one each.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have no other items, will check the combination on the receipt, and share with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらをレジへどうぞ。三種類をお楽しみください。お買い上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please bring these to the register. Enjoy the three varieties. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この柱の案内について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the information on this pillar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 影を見て今の時刻を知りたいです。丸い台に線があるので、日時計だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 丸台の線と影から日時計と思い時刻確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to tell the current time from the shadow. There are lines on the round base, so I thought it was a sundial.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the lines and shadow on the round base made you think it was a sundial and that you want to check the time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは、東西南北の方向を示す案内です。時刻の目盛りはございません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This shows the directions east, west, south, and north. There are no time markings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 時間ではなく方角だったのですね。友人へ何時に戻るか伝えたいので、自分の携帯で時刻を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 方位案内と理解し時刻は携帯で確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it shows direction, not time. I want to tell my friend what time I will return, so I will check the time on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand it shows directions and will check the time on your phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の時刻は確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Were you able to check the current time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後二時です。三十分後に友人と合流します。柱の線の数から、二時半と決める所でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十四時確認後三十分後合流を示し影線で十四時半にしそうだったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is two in the afternoon. I will meet my friend in thirty minutes. I nearly decided it was half past two by counting the lines on the pillar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you checked it is 2 p.m., will meet in thirty minutes, and nearly concluded it was 2:30 from the shadow lines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待ち合わせ場所は、どちらになっていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 南の入口です。この柱の「南」を見て、入口の方を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 南入口合流のため方角表示で位置確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: At the south entrance. I would like to check the direction of the entrance using the “south” marking on this pillar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check the location using the direction sign for your meeting at the south entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 南の表示の先に、入口への案内板があります。そちらの矢印もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Beyond the south marking, there is a sign toward the entrance. Please look at its arrow as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の方向が分かりました。時刻は携帯で二時半、場所は南入口と友人へ送ります。影の線は待ち合わせ時刻には使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時刻十四時半と南入口位置を別情報として友人へ送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I know which way the entrance is now. I will message my friend that the time is half past two, checked on my phone, and the place is the south entrance. I will not use the shadow lines for the meeting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Send the 2:30 p.m. meeting time and the south entrance location as separate information to your friend. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、案内板をご覧になってお進みください。お友達との散歩をお楽しみください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22226-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please follow the information sign. Enjoy your walk with your friend. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 車両の行き先の表示について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the destination display on the train cars?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 青浜へ行きたいです。次の列車の案内に、青浜と山川の二つが出ています。同じ列車なら、どの車両でもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの行き先が表示された列車でどの車両でも目的地へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to go to Aohama. The information for the next train shows both Aohama and Yamakawa. If it is the same train, is any car all right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether any car of a train displaying two destinations will take you to your destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この四両の列車は、途中で分かれます。一号車と二号車は青浜、三号車と四号車は山川へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This four-car train divides along the way. Cars one and two go to Aohama, while cars three and four go to Yamakawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 後ろの二両は山川なのですね。友人から三号車で会おうと言われていましたが、私たちは二人とも青浜へ行く予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後ろ二両の別目的地を理解し青浜行き友人との三号車待合予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the rear two cars go to Yamakawa. My friend told me to meet in car three, but both of us plan to go to Aohama.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you understand the rear two cars have a different destination and that you planned to meet your Aohama-bound friend in car three.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その行き先でしたら、一号車か二号車をお選びください。お友達には、今ご連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: For that destination, please choose car one or two. Can you contact your friend now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、友人はまだ来ていません。二号車へ変更すると伝えます。途中で分かれる駅で移ればよい、と考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未到着の友人へ二号車変更を伝え途中移動を想定していたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, my friend has not arrived yet. I will say we are changing to car two. I had thought we could move at the station where the train divides.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your friend, who has not arrived, to change to car two and that you had expected to move partway along.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中の移動を前提にせず、ここで青浜へ向かう車両へお乗りください。乗車前に車両番号と行き先をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please board a car bound for Aohama here, rather than relying on changing partway. Check the car number and destination before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二号車と青浜の表示を両方見ます。二号車を待つ位置も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二号車番号と青浜表示を確認するため待機位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check both car two and the Aohama display. Please also show me where to wait for car two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese where to wait so you can check the car-two number and Aohama display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 足元の二号車の案内はこちらです。列車が来ましたら、車両の番号と青浜の表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The car-two marking on the platform is here. When the train arrives, please also check the car number and Aohama display on the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。友人にも、三号車は山川へ向かうので、乗る前に二号車の位置へ来てほしいと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定二号車位置で待ち友人にも乗車前の位置変更を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait here. I will also tell my friend that car three goes to Yamakawa and ask them to come to the car-two position before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait at the designated car-two position and tell your friend to change positions before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、車両ごとの表示をご確認のうえご乗車ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check each car’s display before boarding. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内冊子をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for an information booklet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。職場の休憩室へ置きたいです。同僚が別々の時間に読むので、一冊だけでなく何部か頂けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同僚の別時間閲覧用に市冊子複数部を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to put some in the break room at work. My colleagues read at different times, so could I have several copies rather than just one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for multiple copies of the city booklet for colleagues who read at different times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この冊子はお持ち帰り用です。ご希望の部数を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This booklet is for taking home. Please tell me how many copies you would like.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五部お願いします。同じ休憩時間にならない同僚にも、一部ずつ渡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同僚へ一部ずつ配るため五部希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Five copies, please. I would like to give one each to colleagues whose break times differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want five copies to give colleagues one each.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの在庫から五部お渡しできます。同じ冊子でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can give you five copies from our stock here. Would you like the same booklet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ物でお願いします。表紙の違う観光案内ではなく、暮らしの相談先が載っている方です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 観光でなく暮らし相談案内五部を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The same one, please. I mean the one listing places to consult about daily life, rather than the tourist guide with a different cover.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose five copies of the daily-life consultation guide rather than the tourism guide. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、この暮らしの案内を五部ご用意します。窓口の情報は発行時点の内容です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will prepare five copies of this daily-life guide. The service-counter information is current as of publication.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 発行日は表紙のこちらですね。相談に行く同僚には、出掛ける前に窓口の情報を確認するよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 冊子の発行日を確かめ相談前の窓口情報確認を同僚へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The publication date is here on the cover, right? I will tell colleagues going for advice to check the counter information before setting out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the booklet’s publication date and say you will tell colleagues to verify service-counter information before seeking advice. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will put them in a bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五部ありますね。職場へ持ち帰って、読みたい同僚へ配ります。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 五部を数えて職場へ持ち帰り希望する同僚へ配ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: There are five, right. I will take them back to work and give them to colleagues who want to read them. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Count five copies and say you will take them to work and distribute them to interested colleagues. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお役立てください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you find them useful. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to consult about medical care?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。たばこをやめることを相談したいです。相談できる担当がいるか、まず受付先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 禁煙について担当有無と受付先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to discuss quitting smoking. First, please tell me where to register and whether there is someone I can consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether someone handles smoking-cessation consultations and where to register.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。すでにたばこをやめているのではなく、今から相談するご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the person in charge. You have not already quit smoking; you would like to consult about it now, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今も吸っています。少し減らしましたが、やめられてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 喫煙量を少し減らしたが現在も吸っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I still smoke. I have cut down a little, but I have not managed to quit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have reduced smoking a little but still smoke.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望をお伝えします。以前、やめようとしたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass on your request. Have you tried to quit before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一度あります。一週間ほど吸いませんでしたが、その後また吸い始めました。今回の相談ではそのことも話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 以前一週間禁煙後再開した経験を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Once. I did not smoke for about a week, but afterward I started again. I would like to discuss that in this consultation as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your previous experience of quitting for a week and then starting again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談する時は、現在の状況と以前の経験を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you have the consultation, please tell the person in charge about your current situation and previous experience.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回は、一人で急にやめようとする前に相談したいです。相談では、どんなことを聞かれるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 専門相談で聞かれる内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: This time, I would like to consult before trying to stop suddenly on my own. What kinds of things will they ask at the consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese what you will be asked during the professional consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の方法と合わせて担当へ確認します。普段の喫煙の様子と、先ほどの経験を伝えられるようにしておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the person in charge, along with the registration process. Please be ready to describe your usual smoking habits and the experience you just mentioned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今日すぐ治療が始まると考えず、必要な受付と予約を聞いてから準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日治療を想定せず受付予約の確認後準備を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will not assume treatment will start immediately today; I will prepare after asking about the necessary registration and appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will prepare after confirming registration and booking, without assuming treatment will begin today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ確認してご案内します。それでは、失礼します。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with the person in charge and let you know. Goodbye for now. Take care.
